review_scope: Checked all final points against cited ledger excerpts and original supplied documents; no independent truth verification.
checks: Business description, official revenue, results period, and net profit match the press release.
Margin narrowing is distinguished from growth in absolute profit.
Expansion remains expected; capex spending progress is separated from funding.
Latest pledge figure retains the promoter-holding denominator.
Working capital delays, copper cost exposure, and the GST demand are retained.
Management statements about defaults, appeal intentions and expected impact remain attributed.
Revenue discrepancy is recorded without guessing its cause.
No buy/sell rating, invented share price, analyst consensus or wrong-entity penalty.
remaining_limitations: The label modest for the debt ratio is an interpretive assessment, not a reported source label.
The copper-price percentage is from a secondary media source; it is not independently verified.
Appeal progress requires an updated filing; the supplied disclosure only states an intention to appeal.
Source truth, semantic entailment, arithmetic, and future free-tier availability are not guaranteed.
